models_evaluated: deep learning histology classifier with uncertainty estimation

links.outcome: Cross-site performance and effect of stain harmonization on inter-laboratory color discrepancies
links.effect: Patient-level accuracy 97.5% on internal cross-validation and 95% on external cohorts; stain transfer module mitigated inter-laboratory color discrepancies, supporting consistent performance across centers.
links.quote: The stain transfer module also effectively mitigated inter-laboratory color discrepancies, supporting consistent model performance across different centers.

unlisted_practices: Uncertainty-triggered selective immunohistochemistry testing for low-confidence AI predictions
CycleGAN-based stain transfer to harmonize staining across institutions

screen.reason: The study tests an uncertainty-aware deployment framework/workflow practice where low-confidence histology AI outputs trigger targeted secondary IHC testing, reducing redundant testing while maintaining high accuracy across multi-center cohorts.
